title: WebSocketClientHandshaker07 may throw NPE
body:
While using Netty 3.6.1.Final to test undertow WebSocket Server we noticed a NPE:

10:20:39,523 WARNING (main) [org.jboss.netty.channel.DefaultChannelFuture] null:-1 An exception was thrown by ChannelFutureListener.: java.lang.NullPointerException
